idea-plugin.name: JTools
idea-plugin.description:
JTools is a powerful and lightweight plugin management container designed specifically for JetBrains IDEs. It revolutionizes the plugin development experience by providing hot-plugging capabilities, allowing developers to install, update, and uninstall plugins without restarting the IDE.
📖 Documentation | 🐛 Report Issues | 📦 Releases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🤖 Agent Chat: Built-in agent entry with streaming output, reasoning blocks, and collapsible tool logs.
  • 📊 Token Usage: Agent chat shows per-session token consumption in K units near the prompt selector, with input/output and last-request details in the tooltip.
  • 🧭 Provider Manager: Multi-provider configuration (OpenAI/Anthropic) with base URL, headers, and proxy.
  • 🎛️ Provider Selector: Provider selector with model lists fetched from each provider.
  • 🧩 Provider Templates: OpenAI-compatible provider types and vendor templates with preset endpoints and parameter hints for easier third-party model integration.
  • 🌍 Broad Provider Coverage: Built-in templates for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Ollama, and Anthropic-style integrations.
  • 🧰 Function Calling: Aggregated plugin and system tools with unique identifiers to avoid name conflicts.
  • 🧩 Structured MCP CLI Tool: A single cli tool covers MCP server configuration, connection tests, resource reads, and tool calls, with a doc command returning the full MCP command reference.
  • 🔌 MCP Client: Manage and call external MCP servers over stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP on the official MCP Java SDK, with persisted server configs and connection testing.
  • 📦 Plugin Ops: Local/URL/batch install and uninstall tool calls for faster workflows.
  • 🧪 Dev Testing: Developer panel can expose current plugin instance tool calls for debugging.
  • 📎 Attachment Workflow: Attach local files and images to chat, with model-aware capability checks, clipboard support, and optimized upload handling.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Inputs: Per-model capability switches for image, audio, video, and file attachments, with automatic text extraction for readable files.
  • 🧠 Skill Management: Import or edit local SKILL.md skills, attach them per session, and expose skill resources directly to the agent runtime.
  • 📚 Skill Resources: references/examples/scripts resources can be mounted into agent sessions and read through dedicated resource tools.
  • 🔗 Skill Runtime Integration: Skills share the same runtime Toolkit as built-in and plugin tools, keeping SkillBox tool groups aligned with the active agent session.
  • 🎚️ Model Tuning: Configure per-model streaming, multimodal capabilities, and advanced OpenAI/Anthropic parameters from a dedicated tuning panel.
  • 🧾 Parameter Guidance: Store provider-level default and recommended parameters to make model configuration more repeatable across sessions.
  • 💾 Session Persistence: Restore sessions, enabled skills, draft attachments, and active context across projects for long-running conversations.
  • 🧠 Runtime State: Session runtime can preserve memory, tool state, and planning context for more consistent multi-step workflows.
  • ⚙️ Agent Limits: Configurable max tool iterations and tool result size limits to prevent oversized context.
  • 📂 File Listing: jtools_list_files supports maxEntries with truncation metadata.
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: WebFetch works as a direct HTTP client with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw bodies, form params, timeout control, and Web tool proxy settings.
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Browser tools can open a temporary JCEF browser session, run visible or hidden after user choice, read pages, observe element refs, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and destroy the dynamic tool window when finished.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution
  • Connecting private or third-party model services through vendor templates without rebuilding the plugin workflow

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档 | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🤖 智能体对话：内置智能体入口，支持流式输出、推理块展示与工具调用折叠日志。
  • 📊 Token 消耗：智能体对话在提示词选择器旁展示当前会话 Token 累计消耗，按 K 单位显示，并在提示中提供输入/输出与上次请求明细。
  • 🧭 供应方管理：多供应方配置（OpenAI/Anthropic），支持 Base URL、请求头、代理。
  • 🎛️ 供应方选择：对话中可选供应方，并维护供应方级别模型列表与默认模型。
  • 🧩 供应方模板：支持 OpenAI Compatible 接入类型与厂商模板，预置端点和参数建议，便于接入第三方模型服务。
  • 🌍 广泛供应方覆盖：内置 OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、DashScope、Gemini、Ollama、Anthropic 等接入模板。
  • 🧰 函数调用：聚合插件与系统工具并增加唯一标识，避免名称冲突。
  • 🧩 结构化 MCP CLI 工具：单一 cli 工具聚合 MCP 服务配置、连接测试、资源读取和工具调用，并通过 doc 一次性返回全部 MCP 命令参数说明。
  • 🔌 MCP 客户端：基于官方 MCP Java SDK 管理并调用外部 MCP 服务，支持 stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP 传输，服务配置持久化并可连接测试。
  • 📦 插件管理：支持本地/URL/批量安装与卸载的工具调用。
  • 🧪 开发测试：开发面板可暴露当前插件实例的工具调用用于调试。
  • 📎 附件工作流：对话支持本地文件和图片附件，具备模型能力校验、剪贴板支持与上传优化。
  • 🖼️ 多模态输入：可按模型开启图片、音频、视频、文件附件能力，并对可读文件自动抽取文本上下文。
  • 🧠 Skills 管理：支持导入或编辑本地 SKILL.md 技能，按会话挂载，并将技能资源直接暴露给智能体运行时。
  • 📚 Skills 资源：references/examples/scripts 等资源文件可随技能挂载，并通过专用资源工具读取。
  • 🔗 Skill 运行时集成：Skills 与内置工具、插件工具共享同一个运行时 Toolkit，使 SkillBox 工具组与当前智能体会话保持一致。
  • 🎚️ 模型调优：提供独立模型调优面板，可配置流式输出、多模态能力以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 高级参数。
  • 🧾 参数建议：支持保存供应方默认参数与推荐参数，让模型配置在不同会话中更容易复用。
  • 💾 会话持久化：跨项目保留会话、启用的技能、草稿附件与当前上下文，适合长会话持续协作。
  • 🧠 运行时状态：会话运行时可保留记忆、工具状态与规划上下文，适合多步骤连续任务。
  • ⚙️ 智能体限制：可配置最大工具调用轮次并限制工具返回长度，避免超大上下文。
  • 📂 文件列表：jtools_list_files 支持 maxEntries 并返回截断信息。
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制和 Web 工具代理。
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：浏览器工具可创建临时 JCEF 浏览器会话，在用户选择后显示或隐藏运行，支持读取页面、观察元素 ref、点击、输入、等待、截图，并在完成后销毁动态工具窗口。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发
  • 通过厂商模板快速接入私有或第三方模型服务，而不必重建整套插件工作流

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🚀 Version v1.1.4.9

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • 🧩 Cross-split Tab Drag: Migrated the more polished two-pane drag: dragging out removes the tab from the source split, a ghost label follows the cursor, and a highlighted placeholder shows the drop position for WYSIWYG insertion
  • 🧭 Splitter Layout Convergence: A single refreshSplitterLayout manages left/right mounting, divider visibility, and empty/content page switching, fixing the missing divider after moving tabs
  • 📚 VFS URL File Read: read_project_files now accepts VFS URLs (jar://, jrt://, file://) returned by find_project_files / find_project_classes with include_global=true, for reading dependency or SDK sources
  • 🏷️ Content Source Marker: Read results mark content_kind as project or external
  • 📝 IDE Tool Descriptions Rewritten: Rewrote descriptions of 9 IDE project tools to match their real capabilities, covering batch operations, unsaved content, index sources, and boundary constraints
  • 🔗 Open Chat Links Externally: URLs in the chat now open in the system browser instead of navigating away inside JCEF; the frontend intercepts <a> clicks and a JCEF-level onBeforeBrowse fallback only intercepts user-gesture external links, leaving initial load and internal navigation untouched
  • ⚡ Stop Latency Fix: The stop action now runs entirely on a background thread, avoiding OkHttp shutdown and log writeback on the EDT that froze the UI
  • ✂️ Truncated Tool Output: Tool output over 8KB is no longer dropped entirely; the first 8KB is kept with a truncation note and next-step hint (safely truncated on UTF-8 character boundaries)
  • 🔄 bash refresh_vfs Option: bash can optionally refresh the VFS after running (off by default); pass true when the command changed files that will be read via read_project_files to avoid stale IDE cache
  • 🧩 Stringified JSON Argument Tolerance: Array/object arguments of IDE project tools tolerate models serializing them as JSON strings (e.g. "[{...}]"), accepting only when the parse result is truly an array/object and otherwise reporting a clear error
  • 🔍 Empty Offset Range: Zero-width offset_ranges entries such as [0, 0) are treated as unspecified, so they no longer conflict with line_ranges
  • 🔢 Zero Numeric Argument As Unspecified: Optional integer arguments whose lower bound is 1 (max_lines, max_results, max_results_per_query, timeout_secs, max_bytes, max_response_bytes) fall back to their defaults when a model passes 0, instead of being clamped to 1; context_lines still accepts 0 as a valid value
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.9 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1149
  • 🧩 插件面板跨分屏拖拽：迁移更完善的双栏拖拽实现，拖出即从源分屏移除、幽灵标签随鼠标跟随、目标分屏按落点高亮占位并所见即所得插入
  • 🧭 分屏布局收敛：统一 refreshSplitterLayout 管理左右分屏挂载、分隔条与空/内容页切换，修复移动标签后分隔条不显示的问题
  • 📚 read_project_files 支持 VFS URL：可直接读取 find_project_files / find_project_classes 在 include_global=true 时返回的 jar://、jrt://、file:// 路径，用于查看依赖或 SDK 源码
  • 🏷️ 内容来源标记：读取结果区分 content_kind 为 project 或 external
  • 📝 IDE 工具描述重写：按真实能力重写 9 个 IDE 项目工具的描述，补齐批量、未保存内容、索引来源、边界约束等信息
  • 🔗 对话链接外部浏览器打开：对话框内的 URL 改为交给系统外部浏览器打开，避免在 JCEF 内跳走整个对话页无法返回；前端拦截 <a> 点击、JCEF 层 onBeforeBrowse 兜底，仅拦真实用户手势触发的外链，放行初始加载与内部导航
  • ⚡ 停止对话卡顿修复：停止动作整体放到后台线程，避免在 EDT 上触发 OkHttp 关闭与日志写回导致界面卡顿
  • ✂️ 工具输出截断保留：工具输出超过 8KB 时不再整段丢弃，改为保留前 8KB 并在末尾附截断说明与下一步提示，按 UTF-8 字符边界安全截断
  • 🔄 bash 新增 refresh_vfs 参数：bash 执行后可选刷新 VFS（默认关闭），改动磁盘文件且随后要用 read_project_files 读取时传 true，避免读到 IDE 缓存旧内容
  • 🧩 工具参数兼容字符串化 JSON：IDE 项目工具的数组/对象参数兼容部分模型序列化成 JSON 字符串（如 "[{...}]"）的情况，解析结果确实是数组/对象才接受，否则仍报清晰错误
  • 🔍 零宽区间视为未指定：offset_ranges 中如 [0, 0) 的零宽区间不选中任何字符，现在视为未指定，不再与 line_ranges 误报互斥
  • 🔢 数值参数 0 视为未指定：max_lines、max_results、max_results_per_query、timeout_secs、max_bytes、max_response_bytes 等下界为 1 的可选参数传 0 时取默认值，不再被夹成 1 导致只读一行或超时一秒；context_lines 的 0 仍是合法值
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.4.9，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1149

🚀 Version v1.1.4.8

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • 📁 Editor File Context: Chat composer can attach the currently opened editor file path to the start of user messages
  • ✂️ Selection Offsets: Selected text is sent as startOffset/endOffset; supports multi-file and multi-caret / block selections within one file
  • 🏷️ Single Aggregated Chip: Multiple selections are summarized into one chip; tooltip lists all paths and offsets
  • 🗂️ Project-Scoped Toggle: File-context enablement is persisted per project path
  • 📖 Offset-aware File Read: read_project_files now accepts offset_ranges to read by character offsets (mutually exclusive with line_ranges)
  • 🛡️ Read-action Safety: Editor selection/document access for file context runs inside a read-action to avoid EDT timer crashes
  • 🧰 Lightweight Tool Detail: Tool detail viewer uses JBTextArea instead of LanguageTextField (no editor dispose maintenance)
  • 🎨 Icon & Interaction: Dedicated file-context icon button; chip can be dismissed; updates follow active file/selection changes
  • 🔢 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.8 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1148
  • 📁 文件上下文开关：对话输入区支持开启文件上下文，将当前编辑器打开文件路径附加到用户消息开头
  • ✂️ 选区 offset 上下文：有选区时附带 startOffset/endOffset；支持多文件，以及同文件多光标/块选的多处选区
  • 🏷️ 单标签汇总展示：多处选区合并为一个 chip，悬停列出全部路径与 offset
  • 🗂️ 项目维度开关：文件上下文开关按项目路径独立持久化，互不影响
  • 📖 read_project_files 支持 offset：读取工具新增 offset_ranges，可按编辑器选区 offset 读取内容，与 line_ranges 二选一
  • 🛡️ 编辑器 read-action 修复：同步文件上下文时在 read-action 内访问选区/文档，避免 EDT Timer 线程异常
  • 🧰 工具详情轻量化：工具详情由 LanguageTextField 改为 JBTextArea，无需维护 Editor dispose
  • 🎨 图标与交互：新增文件上下文图标按钮；chip 支持关闭；切换文件/选区实时刷新
  • 🔢 版本元数据同步：插件版本号更新为 v1.1.4.8，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1148

🚀 Version v1.1.4.7

  • 🧩 Provider Custom Headers: Supplier settings now support a custom request-header list that is sent with provider HTTP calls
  • 💾 provider_config Storage: Headers are persisted under providers.provider_config.custom_headers without a schema migration
  • 🔐 Auth Header Guard: Custom headers cannot override Authorization; system API Key / Anthropic auth headers take precedence
  • 📜 Fixed-Height Header List: The header editor is capped to about five visible rows with internal scrolling to avoid layout push-down
  • 📡 Runtime Coverage: Custom headers are applied to chat requests and remote model listing
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.7 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1147
  • 🧩 供应商自定义请求头：供应商配置支持维护自定义 Header 列表，并随供应商请求一起发送
  • 💾 provider_config 持久化：请求头存储于 providers.provider_config.custom_headers，无需新增数据库字段
  • 🔐 鉴权优先级保护：自定义头禁止覆盖 Authorization，系统 API Key / Anthropic 鉴权头优先
  • 📜 请求头列表固定高度：列表固定约 5 行可视高度，超出后内部滚动，避免把下方配置整体顶下去
  • 📡 运行时全链路生效：对话请求与远程模型列表获取都会带上供应商自定义请求头
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.4.7，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1147

🚀 Version v1.1.4.6

  • 💬 Composer Send Button: Added a theme-aware primary "发送" text button at the bottom-right of the chat input, with loading/disabled states and retained Cmd/Ctrl+Enter shortcuts
  • 🎨 Theme-Matched Send Style: Send button colors now follow the IDE accent token (--jb-accent) across hover, active, and disabled states in light/dark themes
  • ✍️ Textarea Resize Cleanup: Disabled native vertical resize handles on chat input, agent description/extra prompt, persona fields, and related dialogs to keep layouts stable
  • 📐 Maximize Editor Fixes: Fixed collapsed height and double scrollbars in the shared maximize editor used by Extra Prompt and Persona fields; only the editor body scrolls
  • 🧭 Counter/Maximize Layout: Moved the maximize action for Extra Prompt to the field label so it no longer overlaps the character counter
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.6 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1146
  • 💬 对话发送按钮：在输入框右下角增加主题色“发送”文字按钮，支持 loading/禁用状态，并保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 快捷发送
  • 🎨 发送按钮主题适配：按钮颜色跟随 IDE 主题强调色（--jb-accent），悬停/按下/禁用态同步适配浅色与深色主题
  • ✍️ 输入区交互优化：去掉对话输入框、Agent 描述/扩展提示、角色与人格等文本框右下角拖拽拉高，减少布局抖动
  • 📐 最大化编辑弹窗修复：修复扩展提示、角色与人格最大化编辑时高度塌陷与双滚动条问题，仅保留编辑区内一条滚动条
  • 🧭 字数统计与最大化按钮布局：扩展提示的最大化入口移到标签行，避免与右下角字数统计重叠
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.4.6，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1146

📦 Version v1.1.4.5

  • 🧠 LLM Runtime Rewrite: Reworked model calls onto a direct OkHttp/Okio HTTP client with a spec-compliant SSE parser (WHATWG/EventSource line handling) and a unified ModelCancel token that interrupts streaming reads, tool calls, and MCP connections together
  • 🔌 Structured MCP CLI Tool: Consolidated MCP management into a single built-in cli tool, exposing mcp.list, mcp.get, mcp.create, mcp.update, mcp.delete, mcp.test, mcp.tools, mcp.resources, mcp.read_resource, and mcp.call on the official MCP Java SDK with stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP transports and persisted server configs
  • 🧾 CLI Doc Command: Replaced per-command --help with a single command='doc' that returns the full parameter reference for every command at once
  • 🌍 Runtime Context In Prompt: The system preamble now reports the operating system, JVM default charset, and JetBrains project file encoding so the model outputs content in the expected encoding
  • 📎 Unified Attachment Preview: Draft and chat-history attachments now share the same interaction: click an image to preview it full size, click a file to open it in the IDE
  • 🔎 Root-Cause Tool Errors: Tool and MCP failures now unwrap the full cause chain instead of surfacing only the outer wrapper (for example "Client failed to initialize by explicit API call")
  • 🛠️ UX Fixes: Fixed the single-message delete button, nested dialogs closing together on Esc, default-select of built-in tools on agent creation, the add-skill button in Skill management, and a max-height scroll cap on long tool-call lists
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.4.5 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1145
